events.title: Titanic Survival Simulator Together Demo Is Here!
events.summary: Your journey across the Atlantic hasn't gone as planned, and now your main objective is to escape the sinking ship before it's too late. Explore cabins and corridors, search for safe routes, and fight to survive the freezing water. With every step, things get more dangerous: familiar passages become flooded, the lights go out, and the darkness slowly wears away at your sanity.Can you escape the Titanic?Try the Titanic Survival Simulator Together demo during Steam Next Fest, October 19–26, 2026.
